description: This file defines the TimesheetService class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing timesheets including creation, data retrieval, and workflow integration. It encapsulates core business logic related to timesheet operations in the Human Resource Management application.

classes.name: TimesheetService
classes.description: Core service class managing timesheet operations such as creation, retrieval, and workflow actions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy loader for the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance.

methods.name: getTimesheetDao
methods.description: Lazy loader for the TimesheetDao instance.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy loader for the TimesheetPeriodService instance.

methods.name: getDetailedTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves a detailed view of a timesheet with associated rows and columns.

methods.name: getTimesheetData
methods.description: Compiles timesheet data into rows and columns based on the date range and items.

methods.name: createTimesheetByDate
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for a specific week based on a given date, setting initial state and date boundaries.

methods.name: extractStartDateAndEndDateFromDate
methods.description: Calculates week boundaries based on a specific date and week start configuration.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for a particular employee on a specific date.

methods.name: createTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Generates TimesheetItem entities from input rows, validating presence of required attributes.

methods.name: generateTimesheetItemKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key string for a timesheet item based on its identifiers and date.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Converts rows into timesheet items and persists them via the DAO.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowsForTimesheet
methods.description: Determines permissible workflow actions for a given timesheet and user role.
